Quelle est la première date de la base ?.sql: SELECT MIN(date) FROM v_pnl UNION ALL SELECT MIN(date) FROM v_risque_book UNION ALL SELECT MIN(date) FROM v_limites UNION ALL SELECT MIN(date) FROM v_marche

Combien de jours de bourse en octobre 20.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT date) FROM v_pnl WHERE date BETWEEN '2026-10-01' AND '2026-10-31' LIMIT 1000

Taux USD 5Y au dernier jour ?.sql: SELECT valeur FROM v_marche WHERE serie = 'USD_5Y' AND date = (SELECT MAX(date) FROM v_marche) LIMIT 1000

Taux EUR 2Y moyen sur juillet 2026 ?.sql: SELECT AVG(valeur) FROM v_marche WHERE serie = 'EUR_2Y' AND date BETWEEN CAST('2026-07-01' AS DATE) AND CAST('2026-07-31' AS DATE) LIMIT 1000

EURUSD moyen sur toute la période ?.sql: SELECT AVG(valeur) FROM v_marche WHERE serie = 'EURUSD' LIMIT 1000

Taux USD 10Y le plus haut de la période.sql: SELECT MAX(valeur) FROM v_marche WHERE serie = 'USD_10Y' LIMIT 1000

Pente 10Y-2Y USD le 15 octobre 2026 ?.sql: SELECT (SELECT valeur FROM v_marche WHERE serie = 'USD_10Y' AND date = CAST('2026-10-15' AS DATE)) - (SELECT valeur FROM v_marche WHERE serie = 'USD_2Y' AND date = CAST('2026-10-15' AS DATE)) LIMIT 1000

Pente 5Y-2Y EUR au dernier jour ?.sql: SELECT (SELECT valeur FROM v_marche WHERE serie = 'EUR_5Y' AND date = (SELECT MAX(date) FROM v_marche)) - (SELECT valeur FROM v_marche WHERE serie = 'EUR_2Y' AND date = (SELECT MAX(date) FROM v_marche)) LIMIT 1000

Variation de l'EURUSD entre le 1er septe.sql: SELECT (SELECT valeur FROM v_marche WHERE serie = 'EURUSD' AND date = CAST('2026-09-30' AS DATE)) - (SELECT valeur FROM v_marche WHERE serie = 'EURUSD' AND date = CAST('2026-09-01' AS DATE)) LIMIT 1000

Écart de P&L entre le book TAUX_EUR et l.sql: SELECT (SELECT SUM(pnl_eur) FROM v_pnl WHERE book = 'TAUX_EUR') - (SELECT SUM(pnl_eur) FROM v_pnl WHERE book = 'TAUX_USD') LIMIT 1000

Part du P&L total due au desk Change.sql: SELECT (SELECT SUM(pnl_eur) FROM v_pnl WHERE desk = 'Change') / (SELECT SUM(pnl_eur) FROM v_pnl) LIMIT 1000

Écart-type de la VaR du book TAUX_EUR ?.sql: SELECT STDDEV_SAMP(var99_1j_eur) FROM v_risque_book WHERE book = 'TAUX_EUR' LIMIT 1000

Médiane de l'ES du book FX_SPOT ?.sql: SELECT MEDIAN(es975_1j_eur) FROM v_risque_book WHERE book = 'FX_SPOT' LIMIT 1000

Combien de jours le P&L du book TAUX_USD.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM v_risque_book WHERE book = 'TAUX_USD' AND pnl_eur > 0 LIMIT 1000

Classe les traders par P&L total croissa.sql: SELECT trader, SUM(pnl_eur) AS pnl_total FROM v_pnl GROUP BY trader ORDER BY pnl_total ASC LIMIT 1000

Classe les books par VaR moyenne décrois.sql: SELECT book, AVG(var99_1j_eur) AS var_moyenne FROM v_risque_book GROUP BY book ORDER BY var_moyenne DESC LIMIT 1000

VaR du book FX_SPOT le 2 octobre 2026 ?.sql: SELECT var99_1j_eur FROM v_risque_book WHERE book = 'FX_SPOT' AND date = CAST('2026-10-02' AS DATE) LIMIT 1000

Utilisation de limite de TAUX_USD le 30.sql: SELECT utilisation_pct FROM v_limites WHERE book = 'TAUX_USD' AND date = CAST('2026-09-30' AS DATE) LIMIT 1000

Delta FX total du book FX_SPOT au dernie.sql: SELECT SUM(delta_fx_eur) FROM v_positions WHERE book = 'FX_SPOT' AND date = (SELECT MAX(date) FROM v_positions) LIMIT 1000

Delta FX net par devise au dernier jour.sql: SELECT devise, SUM(notionnel) AS notional_net FROM v_positions WHERE date = (SELECT MAX(date) FROM v_positions) GROUP BY devise LIMIT 1000

ES moyenne en août 2026 par book.sql: SELECT book, AVG(es975_1j_eur) AS es_moyenne FROM v_risque_book WHERE date BETWEEN CAST('2026-08-01' AS DATE) AND CAST('2026-08-31' AS DATE) GROUP BY book LIMIT 1000

Nombre de positions long (notionnel posi.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM v_positions WHERE notionnel > 0 AND date = (SELECT MAX(date) FROM v_positions) LIMIT 1000

Notionnel du plus gros long au dernier j.sql: SELECT MAX(notionnel) AS notionnel FROM v_positions WHERE date = (SELECT MAX(date) FROM v_positions) LIMIT 1000
